description: This file contains an implementation of the ApplicationInfoDao interface, specifically the ApplicationInfoDaoImpl class. It provides methods to query the database and retrieve application information objects (AppInfo) from the 'app_info' table.

classes.name: ApplicationInfoDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ApplicationInfoDao interface providing database access logic to fetch application info records.

methods.name: loadApplicationInfos
methods.description: Loads application info records from the database table 'app_info' and returns a list of AppInfo objects.
